title: SoundtrackPlayer
description: This mod allows you to play persistent songs or sounds even when you're not in the world/server.
body:
## **Base command:**

/soundtrack <play/stop>

/soundtrack <play> <id> <"sound"> <volume> <fadeinTicks> <fadeoutTicks> <loop> <pitch>

/sountrack <stop> <id>

**With this mod you can add songs from resource packs or Minecraft natively. If you leave the server, the song will continue playing at a reduced volume, and when you rejoin, it will resume as if you had never left.**

**You can also change the volume in real time without affecting the audio if you use the same command with a different volume.**
